Select2 4.1.0-rc.0, the same pinned version used by Scheduler's faculty page.

The minified JavaScript and stylesheet were downloaded unchanged from the [Select2 npm package on jsDelivr](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/select2@4.1.0-rc.0/). Local copies keep the Program Chair faculty dialogs available without a runtime CDN connection. See LICENSE.md for the upstream license.
